blocks.title: The big idea
blocks.body: An array is a row of same-type values under one name, picked by an index that starts at 0. Loops walk it. Functions receive its address and need the length. C never checks the bounds.

blocks.title: Rules
items: Length n means indexes 0 to n - 1

blocks.title: An array parameter
Two dimensions
items: Rows are stored one after another
A function needs the column count: `int g[][3]`

blocks.body: Out of bounds is undefined behavior. Check indexes, and use `-fsanitize=address` to find slips.
